chunks: And from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
When two believers meet, one hundred mercies are showered between them—ninety nine of these go to the one who loves the other more.

key_terms.تَقَابَلَ: to meet or face each other
key_terms.لِأَشَدِّهِمَا حُبًّا: to the one who loves more

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward when two believers meet according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Abdillah (a.s.) teaches that when two believers encounter each other, divine mercy is distributed between them, with a disproportionate share (99 out of 100) granted to the one who harbors greater love for the other. This highlights the spiritual value of mutual affection and love among believers as a source of divine grace.

en.muhajir-b-ali: 57. It has been reported that Abu 'Abd Allah (a.s) said:
When two believers meet, one hundred mercies are showered between them—ninety nine of these go to the one who loves the other more.
